title: Verdacht des schweren Menschenhandels und des gewerbsmäßigen Einschleusens von Ausländern – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt

extraction.summaryEn: Police and prosecutors executed 20 search warrants across eight Berlin districts in an investigation of suspected aggravated human trafficking and commercial smuggling of foreigners. Ten of 18 suspects were found; one officer was slightly injured when a suspect resisted.
